神经退行性疾病.title: Cognitive tests of pattern separation as sleep-sensitive measures in middle-aged and older adults: An exploratory study
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Sleep disturbances are considered both a dementia risk factor and symptom. The present research aimed to identify cognitive tests sensitive to objective sleep quantity or quality, focusing on tests designed to evaluate the earliest cognitive changes in dementia. We recruited adults who were 50 years or older and remotely monitored their sleep patterns for 7 consecutive days using wrist actigraphy and sleep diaries. On day 7, participants completed different cognitive tests; the Psychomotor Vigilance Task (PVT), the Prodromal Alzheimers and Mild Cognitive Impairment battery from the Cambridge Neuropsychological Test Automated Battery (CANTAB), the Mnemonic Similarity Task (MST), taxing pattern separation, and the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA). The final sample included 34 participants (mean age: 65.56, SD: 9.57). There were significant correlations between objective sleep quantity and PVT and MST performance. MoCA scores were correlated with performance on CANTAB and MST. Objective sleep quantity predicted MST performance when controlling for age, sex, and education. Tests of pattern separation are sensitive to objective sleep quantity and early cognitive changes associated with dementia. The sensitivity of pattern separation tests to sleep should be evaluated in a larger study, aiming to identify suitable clinical trial outcome measures for sleep-promoting treatments in older adults.

神经退行性疾病.title: Sex- and age-dependent control of dopamine function by LRRK2, and rapid reversal of dopamine release deficits in the LRRK2-G2019S knock-in mouse model of Parkinson's Disease.
神经退行性疾病.abstract: No disease-modifying therapy exists for Parkinson's disease (PD). At diagnosis (~65y), ~70% of nigrostriatal dopamine (DA) axons may have degenerated, so identifying when and how striatal axon function declines is critical. LRRK2 hyperactivity is observed in LRRK2 and VPS35 familial cases, and also idiopathic PD. Thus suggests LRRK2 hyperfunction is a common pathophysiological feature of PD. LRRK2 inhibitors are currently in human trials, yet their effects on brain circuit function are poorly characterized. By optical imaging of iGluSnFR and dLight we measured striatal glutamate and DA release in WT, LRRK2 G2019S (LKI) and VPS35 D620N (VKI) knock-in mice, across adult ages and sexes, with and without LRRK2 inhibition. In WT mice, ongoing LRRK2 activity regulated DA release in an age- and sex-dependent manner. Acute inhibition reversed basal sex differences in striatal glutamate and DA release in aged mice, and potentiated DA release more in middle-aged females than males. In LKI mice, DA release declined progressively, first in males, then females, after maturation to full adulthood, and remained impaired in very old LKI and VKI mice. Release deficits in aged LKI and VKI mice were resistant to acute LRRK2 inhibition, but 2h inhibition rapidly reversed deficits in middle-aged LKI males and females. We conclude that LRRK2 activity, and inhibition effects, depend on age, sex, and genotype, with direct implications for the design and timing of current LRRK2 inhibitor clinical trials for PD.

神经退行性疾病.title: Understanding Performance Plateaus and Representation Collapse in 3D MRI Transformers Trained to Classify Brain Disease
神经退行性疾病.abstract: In medical imaging AI, we commonly assume that diagnostic classifiers will increase in accuracy if they are trained on more data, but in reality, their performance often plateaus. To understand this behavior, we ran a spectral analysis of 3D vision transformers, a common supervised deep learning model that can be trained to classify disease based on 3D brain MRI. For simpler classification methods such as linear discriminant analysis, the classifier performance AUC(N), when trained on a sample of size N, is known to depend on the encoder's eigenspectrum. Each class-discriminative direction in the latent space contributes only after the sample size N reaches a threshold, so the spectrum influences how performance scales with training data. Building on this theory, we show that supervised transformers compress almost all of their discriminative signal into one principal component (EVR@1 = 0.90--0.96): after this representation collapse happens, no further directions cross the threshold as training data increases, and accuracy plateaus. In principle, this plateau in performance could be due to either the encoder's learned feature space or the difficulty of the task. To distinguish these cases, we trained three types of supervised 3D transformers (ViT3D, MINiT, NIT) and, as a non-collapsing alternative, a frozen self-supervised encoder (DINO), to classify people with dementia or mild cognitive impairment (MCI) versus cognitively normal (CN) individuals from 3D brain MRI, using data from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI). We froze each encoder and applied it to a new task, so that only the task difficulty varied. An easy task encoder (Dementia vs CN), transferred to the harder task (MCI vs CN), did not reproduce the plateau (MINiT threshold 9.2), but full retraining did (2758.5). 神经退行性疾病.title: Depth-Dependent Alterations in Cerebral Blood and Tissue Oxygenation Associated with Tau in Alzheimer's Disease Models
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Vascular dysfunction is an increasingly recognized feature of Alzheimer's disease, and inadequate oxygen delivery may contribute to neuronal death. However, how cerebral oxygenation relates to neuronal pathology remains unclear. Here, we used two-photon phosphorescence lifetime microscopy with Oxyphor2P to measure intravascular and tissue partial pressure of oxygen (pO2) at 0, 100 and 200 um cortical depth in awake rTg4510 and THY-Tau22 mice. Relative to WT, capillary and venular pO2 in rTg4510 mice were elevated at 6 months but reduced at 9 months, mainly in deeper layers, with increased oxygen extraction fraction. Suppressing the tau transgene with doxycycline for three months did not restore vascular pO2. THY-Tau22 mice, despite limited tangle pathology, showed even greater reductions in capillary pO2 at every depth. In 6-month-old rTg4510 mice, tissue pO2 trended lower than in WT, and the fraction of low pO2 values (< 18 mmHg) increased with depth, reaching 33% at 200 um versus 4% in WT. Labeling neurofibrillary tangles with the tau-binding dye HS84 revealed significantly lower tissue pO2 in tangle-positive areas at 100 and 200 um. Longitudinal imaging of 2,282 neurons showed that disappearing neurons were not located in relatively hypoxic tissue within an animal. Finally, ex vivo immunostaining revealed neuronal loss and increased astrogliosis in rTg4510 mice, with unchanged vascular architecture. These results indicate that tau disrupts cerebrovascular and tissue oxygenation in a depth- and age-dependent manner, and that neuronal loss is not explained by a neuron's local oxygen microenvironment but may reflect a global reduction in cortical oxygenation.

神经退行性疾病.title: When longevity becomes chemistry: Why rodent brains lack neuromelanin
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Background: The biology of neuromelanin (NMel) is linked to Parkinson's disease, in which pigment accumulation and release contribute to dopaminergic cell loss. Rodent brains lack detectable levels of NMel, despite possessing the molecular machinery required for its synthesis. The basis for this absence remains unknown. Objectives: To determine whether long-living rodents accumulate NMel and to test whether lifespan constraints explain the lack of pigmentation in mice and rats. Methods: Histological stains were conducted in brain samples of mole rats of different ages to disclose the potential pigmentation of catecholaminergic centers and to determine the chemical phenotype of pigmented neurons. Results: Mole rats exhibited clear age-dependent NMel accumulation beginning after two years of age, with the highest pigmentation levels observed in neurons of the locus coeruleus. Conclusions: Accumulation of NMel is a slow kinetic process that requires extended longevity. Common laboratory rodents lack pigmented brains simply because they do not live long enough to reach detectable NMel levels.

神经退行性疾病.title: Progressive neurodegeneration of the locus coeruleus drives rapid eye movement sleep fragmentation
神经退行性疾病.abstract: Sleep disturbances are common early features of neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Parkinson's disease (PD). AD progression is also characterized by early and substantial degeneration of the noradrenergic locus coeruleus (LC), beginning with tau pathology and progressing to major neuronal loss. Although LC degeneration and sleep disruption progress in parallel, whether LC degeneration causally contributes to sleep abnormalities, and which sleep changes are associated with this process, remain unresolved. Human studies are largely correlative, while existing rodent models poorly reproduce progressive LC degeneration. Here, we employed progressive Caspase-3 (Casp3)-mediated LC ablation, with longitudinal sleep and calcium fiber photometry to monitor LC activity across defined stages of degeneration in adult female DBH-Cre mice. Histological analysis demonstrated graded, time-dependent LC degeneration, yielding mild degeneration (~25% neuronal loss) by day 8 post Casp3 injection and moderate degeneration (~50% loss) by day 18. Relative to baseline and to control mice, LC degeneration led to REM sleep fragmentation, emerging already at the mild degeneration stage. By the moderate stage, total REM sleep during light hours had significantly increased, while EEG theta power during REM sleep progressively declined across all stages of degeneration. Degeneration also blunted state-dependent LC calcium activity, significantly reducing the contrast between wakefulness and REM signal. Together, these results establish Casp3-mediated ablation as a model of progressive LC neurodegeneration and identify REM fragmentation and blunted state-dependent LC activity as its early functional signatures, providing a platform for studying how degeneration of neuromodulatory systems shapes sleep in a neurodegenerative disease-like state.
